title: Employee Board Representation and Capital Investment
authors: Qinglu Jin; Hui Ma; Thomas M Schmid; Guochang Zhang
eligible_reason: Main design is an RDD at the 2,000-domestic-employee threshold (Tables 1-6, 9). The DiD (Tables 7-8, Figures 1-2) uses the 1976 Codetermination Act with a common post window (1979-1981 vs 1973-1975); firms that appear first treated in 1980/1981 are panel gaps, not later adopters (checked in DiDsample.dta: all 10 such firms are unobserved in 1979). The coefficient of interest is the triple interaction POST_TREATED2_GROWTH with continuous GROWTH, and every column adds SIZE, LEVERAGE, PROFIT.
design_notes: Stata. DID code.do: xtreg INVEST GROWTH POST_GROWTH TREATED2_GROWTH POST_TREATED2 POST_TREATED2_GROWTH SIZE LEVERAGE PROFIT i.YEAR if POSITIVE_G==1 (or NEGATIVE_G==1), fe cluster(IDCODE); DiDsample.dta 1,532 firm-years, years 1973-75 and 1979-81. FIGURE Code.do: year-by-treated and year-by-treated-by-growth interactions. RDD code.do: reg INVEST GROWTH TREATED GROWTH_TREATED + polynomial in employees + FF17 and year FE.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Codetermination Act 1976: single policy date; post window 1979-1981 for all treated firms.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common adoption date; continuous-interaction treatment; time-varying controls
specs.treatment_var: POST_TREATED2 (and POST_TREATED2_GROWTH, the coefficient of interest)
specs.controls: GROWTH, POST_GROWTH, TREATED2_GROWTH, SIZE, LEVERAGE, PROFIT
